subject: english

units.name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future

topics.name: 人物成就
topics.description: 认读 achievement、genius、career 和 honour。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「成就」？

topics.name: 科学家与贡献
topics.description: 认读 Nobel、discover、theory 和 devote。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「诺贝尔奖」？

topics.name: that 引导主语从句
topics.description: 能用 that 引导主语从句，或用 it 作形式主语。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: ___ he refused the prize surprised us. 横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: whether 引导主语从句
topics.description: 能用 whether 引导主语从句，并使用陈述语序。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: ___ she will accept the honour is unknown. 横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 描述人物成就
topics.description: 能按时间说明人物做了什么，并给出评价。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说她把一生献给了研究，哪一句合适？
example.answer: She devoted her life to research

topics.name: 读人物短文
topics.description: 根据短文推断作者没有直接说满的态度，并找出事实。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: Tu Youyou devoted many years to research. It is now clear that her discovery saved a great number of patients. Whether every student knows her story is another question. 她把许多年用在了什么上？

topics.name: 写人物简介
topics.description: 能按要点选出人物简介中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：多年研究、发现挽救病人、不是每个学生都知道。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: She devoted years to research, her discovery saved patients, and whether every student knows her is uncertain

topics.name: 未来生活
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 认读 robot、automatic、predict 和 innovation。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「机器人」？

topics.name: 智能设备
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 认读 sensor、remote、appliance 和 warning。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「传感器」？

topics.name: 表语从句
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 能用 that、whether 或疑问词引导表语从句。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: The problem is ___ the sensor fails at night. 横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 同位语从句
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 能用 that 引导同位语从句，并把它和定语从句分开。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: The news ___ the robot won a prize is true. that 在从句中不充当成分，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 描述未来设备
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 能按步骤说明一台设备如何工作。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想按步骤说明机器人如何做饭，哪一句适合作为第一步？
example.answer: First, the sensor checks the food

topics.name: 读未来生活短文
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 根据上下文推断 sensor 出了什么问题，以及作者还不确定什么。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The new robot cooks by itself. The fact that its sensor failed yesterday explains the delay. The question is whether the network can be repaired today. 机器人会做什么？

topics.name: 写步骤说明
topics.unit_name: 第2单元 Looking into the Future
topics.description: 能按要点选出步骤说明中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：机器人会做饭、传感器昨天失灵、网络能否修好还未知。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: The robot can cook, the sensor failed yesterday, and whether the network can be repaired is unknown

topics.name: 公园
topics.description: 认读 park、wildlife、boundary 和 ranger。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「公园」？

topics.name: 自然保护
topics.description: 认读 wetland、species、prohibit 和 ecology。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「湿地」？

topics.name: 动词 -ing 的完成式
topics.description: 能用 having done 表示该动作先于主句动作。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: ___ the trail, they entered the wetland. 表示先走完步道，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: with 复合结构
topics.description: 能用 with 加宾语再加补语，表示伴随的状态。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: He waited, with the lights ___. 表示灯亮着，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 描述公园规则
topics.description: 能按顺序说明参观公园的做法和禁止事项。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想按顺序说明先关门再进入湿地，哪一句合适？
example.answer: Having closed the gate, enter the wetland quietly

topics.name: 读公园短文
topics.description: 读短文，判断哪一条是规则，哪一条是已经做完的动作。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: Having checked the map, we followed the trail into the wetland. Feeding birds is prohibited. With the ranger leading us, we stayed inside the boundary. 他们进入湿地之前做了什么？

topics.name: 写参观说明
topics.description: 能按要点选出参观说明中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：先看地图、禁止投喂、护林员带路。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: Having checked the map, remember that feeding is prohibited, and follow the ranger

topics.name: 肢体语言
topics.description: 认读 gesture、posture、expression 和 contact。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「手势」？

topics.name: 表情与距离
topics.description: 认读 frown、nod、distance 和 interpret。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「皱眉」？

topics.name: 非谓语的完成式和被动式
topics.description: 能在语境中使用 having been done，表示先被完成。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: ___ by the host, the guests sat down. 表示已经被迎接过，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 感官动词后的宾补
topics.description: 能在 see、hear、notice 后面选择省略 to 的不定式或 -ing。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: I saw her ___ . 表示看见她点头的全过程，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 描述肢体语言
topics.description: 能描述一个手势或表情，并说明它可能表示什么。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说点头常常表示同意，哪一句合适？

topics.name: 读肢体语言短文
topics.description: 根据上下文推断 nod 和 frown 分别暗示什么。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: Having been greeted, the guests sat down. I saw the host nod, which I interpreted as agreement. A frown, however, made the speaker keep a greater distance. 客人坐下之前发生了什么？

topics.name: 写观察笔记
topics.description: 能按要点选出观察笔记中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：先被问候、点头表示同意、皱眉后拉开距离。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: Having been greeted they sat down, a nod meant agreement, and a frown made the speaker keep a distance

topics.name: 农业
topics.description: 认读 agriculture、crop、soil 和 harvest。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「农业」？

topics.name: 耕作
topics.description: 认读 fertilizer、irrigation、yield 和 organic。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「肥料」？

topics.name: 不定式的被动式
topics.description: 能用 to be done 表示将要被做或应该被做。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: The crops are ___ tomorrow. 表示明天将被收割，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 独立主格
topics.description: 能识别独立主格：名词加上分词，逻辑主语和主句主语不同。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: Weather ___, we will start the harvest. 表示如果天气允许，横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 说明农事过程
topics.description: 能说明耕作步骤，并就产量和土壤给出有依据的看法。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说土壤需要被检测，哪一句合适？
example.answer: The soil needs to be tested

topics.name: 读农业短文
topics.description: 读短文，找出必须先做的事和仍然取决于天气的事。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The wheat is to be harvested next week. Soil samples need to be tested first. Weather permitting, the farmers will finish the work in three days. 小麦什么时候将被收割？

topics.name: 写农事安排
topics.description: 能按要点选出安排说明中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：下周收割、先检测土壤、天气允许就三天做完。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: The wheat is to be harvested next week, the soil is to be tested first, and weather permitting they will finish in three days

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「成就」？
questions.explain: achievement 的意思是成就。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「genius」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: genius 的意思是天赋。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「事业」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示事业的单词是 career。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「荣誉」？
questions.explain: honour 的意思是荣誉。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「诺贝尔奖」？
questions.explain: Nobel 的意思是诺贝尔奖。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「discover」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: discover 的意思是发现。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「理论」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示理论的单词是 theory。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「奉献」？
questions.explain: devote 的意思是奉献。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: ___ he refused the prize surprised us. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 主语从句不缺成分、表示一件事，用 That。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句用 it 作形式主语？
questions.explain: It is clear that 后面才是真正的主语从句。
options: That is clear she devoted her life
Clear that she devoted is it
It is clear that she devoted her life to research

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: ___ he discovered is still unknown. 从句缺少发现的内容，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 从句缺少宾语时用 What，不能用 That。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句是正确的？
questions.explain: That 从句作主语时，谓语用单数 has。
options: That the theory works has been proved
The theory works has been proved
That the theory works have been proved
Which the theory works has been proved

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: ___ she will accept the honour is unknown. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 主语从句放在句首表示“是否”时用 Whether，不用 If。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句语序正确？
questions.explain: whether 从句用陈述语序 he is。
options: Whether is he a genius is not important
If he is a genius is not important
Whether he is a genius is not important

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is uncertain ___ they discovered the cause. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 不确定“是否”用 whether。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句不能放在句首？
questions.explain: If 不能引导放在句首的主语从句。
options: Whether she will come is unknown
If she will come is unknown
That she will come is certain
What she will say is unknown

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说她把一生献给了研究，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: devoted her life to 用来概括事业。
options: She not devoted her life to research
She devoted her life to reseerch
She devoted her life to research

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说她是否得奖还不清楚，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 句首用 Whether，语序是 she will get。
options: Whether she will get the honour is unknown
If she will get the honour is unknown
Whether will she get the honour is unknown

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想先给结论再说事实，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: It is clear that 先给评价。
options: It is clear his discovery changed that
It is clear that his discovery changed medicine

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想按步骤介绍人物，哪一句适合作为第二步？
questions.explain: Next 用来连接步骤。
options: Next, he was published the theory

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tu Youyou devoted many years to research. It is now clear that her discovery saved a great number of patients. Whether every student knows her story is another question. 她把许多年用在了什么上？
questions.explain: 短文写 devoted many years to research。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tu Youyou devoted many years to research. It is now clear that her discovery saved a great number of patients. Whether every student knows her story is another question. 她的发现带来了什么？
questions.explain: 短文写 saved a great number of patients。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tu Youyou devoted many years to research. It is now clear that her discovery saved a great number of patients. Whether every student knows her story is another question. 哪一件事作者说还不一定？
questions.explain: Whether every student knows her story 表示这件事不确定。
options: 是不是每个学生都知道她的故事

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tu Youyou devoted many years to research. It is now clear that her discovery saved a great number of patients. Whether every student knows her story is another question. 作者对这项发现的态度更接近哪一种？
questions.explain: saved a great number of patients 说明作者认为发现重要。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要点：多年研究、发现挽救病人、不是每个学生都知道。哪一句三个要点都有？
questions.explain: 三个要点都要出现。
options: She devoted years to research, her discovery saved patients, and whether every student knows her is uncertain

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 简介用形式主语评价发现，哪一句正确？
questions.explain: It is important that 后面用陈述句。
options: It is important we remember that this
It is important that we remember this achievement

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为简介的第一句？
questions.explain: 简介可以先说明 This paragraph introduces。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句的主语从句用了 Whether？
questions.explain: 句首用 Whether，语序是 the story is。
options: Whether the story is widely known matters
If the story is widely known matters
Whether is the story known matters

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「机器人」？
questions.explain: robot 的意思是机器人。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「automatic」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: automatic 的意思是自动的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「预测」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示预测的单词是 predict。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「创新」？
questions.explain: innovation 的意思是创新。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「传感器」？
questions.explain: sensor 的意思是传感器。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「remote」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: remote 的意思是远程的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「家用电器」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示家用电器的单词是 appliance。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「网络」？
questions.explain: network 的意思是网络。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The problem is ___ the sensor fails at night. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 从句不缺成分，表语从句用 that。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The question is ___ the robot can cook. 表示“是否”，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 表示是否用 whether。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句语序正确？
questions.explain: 表语从句用陈述语序 the appliance stops。
options: That is why does the appliance stop
That is why stops the appliance
That is why the appliance stops
Why that is the appliance stops

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What I need is ___ the network is stable. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: is 后面的从句不缺成分，用 that。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The news ___ the robot won a prize is true. that 在从句中不充当成分，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: news 的内容是一整件事，用 that 引导同位语从句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句是同位语从句？
questions.explain: that the sensor failed 是 fact 的内容，that 不作成分。
options: The sensor that failed was new
The robot which we bought is small
The fact that the sensor failed surprised them
The prize which he won is gold

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句是定语从句而不是同位语从句？
questions.explain: which he wrote 里 which 作 wrote 的宾语，是定语从句。
options: The report that he was late is false
The idea that robots will cook is new
The news that she won is true
The report which he wrote is short

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We heard the warning ___ the network might break. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: warning 的具体内容用 that 同位语从句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想按步骤说明机器人如何做饭，哪一句适合作为第一步？
questions.explain: First 用来开始步骤。
options: First, the sensor check the food
First, the sensor checking the food
First, the sensor checks the food

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说问题在于网络不稳定，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 表语从句用 that 加陈述语序。
options: The problem is that is the network not stable
The problem is why does it stop
The problem is that the network is not stable
